text.title: Django + Celery Background Jobs Output Contract
text.summary: JSON Schema (draft-07) for the code artefact this methodology produces. Validator in scripts/validate-django-celery.py enforces required keys, enum bounds, and pattern constraints; the forbidden-pattern list below is checked by review, not by the schema.

section.title: Schema

example.note: All required keys present; enums, bounds and the dotted task_name pattern satisfied.

Forbidden traits: task_name not dotted snake_case; max_retries>5 or <0; dispatch_mode/idempotency/dlq_strategy not in enum; missing business_key/queue/soft_time_limit/time_limit/dlq_queue/alerting_channel.

forbidden.pattern: Task without an explicit name= argument (relies on module-path auto-discovery)
Task without a declared idempotency strategy
Task without both soft_time_limit and time_limit
Worker started with no -Q queue arg (consumes the default queue only)
Model instances passed as task arguments instead of primitive ids

allowed-transformations.transformation: Default retry_backoff and retry_jitter to true when omitted.
Derive time_limit as soft_time_limit + 30 when only the soft limit is given.
